description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for managing currency localisation in the OpenCart admin interface. It includes methods for listing, adding, editing, enabling, disabling, deleting, and refreshing currency data, and constructs various URLs for navigation and operations.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Controller class for handling currency localisation in the OpenCart admin panel, providing CRUD operations, status toggling, and refresh functionality for currencies.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method that loads the currency list view, setting page title and navigation links.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of currencies in output, mainly calls getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Constructs and returns the HTML view for listing currencies with pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a currency, pre-filling fields when editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving currency data, both creating new entries and updating existing ones, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected currencies by setting their status to active.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected currencies by setting their status to inactive.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected currencies after validation of dependencies and permissions.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Queues a background task to refresh currency exchange rates.
